2. Reason: The Planner in Step 5 has hallucinated the dates for the battles. It incorrectly swapped the dates: it states the Battle of Belleau Wood occurred from September 15 to November 27, 1944 (which are actually the dates for Peleliu) and the Battle of Peleliu occurred from June 1 to June 26, 1918 (which are the dates for Belleau Wood). This leads to the incorrect conclusion that Peleliu occurred earlier, when in reality, Belleau Wood (1918) occurred earlier than Peleliu (1944).
